name: astro-dev-mock-generator
description: Astro Dev Toolbar app that generates synthetic, realistic mock data for Astro Content Collections without cluttering local markdown files using Gemini Nano

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/app.ts --outdir ./dist && bun x tsc src/index.ts src/app.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --moduleResolution bundler --target ESNext --module ESNext --skipLibCheck

author: bhubbard
